items.prompt: What does the deliberate child exit status 7 mean here?

options.text: Every status 7 is a memory crash on all platforms
options.why: This program explicitly asks for that exit code.

options.text: The child requested a nonzero completion status
options.why: Interpret status under this exact program/platform contract.

options.text: check=False changes that nonzero returncode to zero
options.why: check=False prevents CalledProcessError for this exit; it preserves the actual returncode for explicit inspection.

options.text: The parent must silently call it success

items.explanation: Nonzero completion, launch failure, timeout and crash are distinct outcomes to diagnose.
